Citation:	Lamy, Frank (2024): Pacific Antarctic Cirumpolar Current strength at Site PS75/076 [dataset]. PANGAEA, https://doi.org/10.1594/PANGAEA.965447, 
	In: Lamy, F (2024): Pacific Antarctic Cirumpolar Current strength reconstrucion [dataset bundled publication]. PANGAEA, https://doi.org/10.1594/PANGAEA.965443
Abstract:	The data contain the ACC strength record at site PS75/076. The absolute ACC strength record was calculated from sortable silt data using a formula from the Scotia Sea by McCave et al. (2017). The sortable silt record was calculated from ln(Zr/Rb) using a regional calibration from discrete grain-size measurement . The ln(Zr(/Rb record was interpolated to 0.5 kyr and 9-point adjacent averaged.
Keyword(s):	Age model; Stratigraphy
Related to:	McCave, I Nicholas; Thornalley, David J R; Hall, Ian R (2017): Relation of sortable silt grain-size to deep-sea current speeds: Calibration of the 'Mud Current Meter'. Deep Sea Research Part I: Oceanographic Research Papers, 127, 1-12, https://doi.org/10.1016/j.dsr.2017.07.003
